name: @zt-playground/mcp-server

tools.name: my_work
tools.description: What to pick up now: your open issues grouped by status, ordered by priority, with blockers flagged, the active cycle, and the unclaimed backlog. Start a working session here instead of chaining search_issues + list_cycles.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

assignee.description: Whose work to show — name, email, id, or "me" (default)

tools.name: issue_brief
tools.description: Everything needed to start work on one issue, in a single call: description, cycle, parent/sub-issues, relations with open blockers called out, recent comments, the linked repository and branch name, git activity, and other recent issues touching the same area.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

includeGit.description: Include commits/PRs linked to the issue

includeNeighbours.description: Include other recent issues in the same affected area

comments.description: How many of the latest comments to include

tools.name: start_work
tools.description: Claims an issue and opens the work: refuses if an open issue still blocks it (unless force), assigns it to you, moves it to IN_PROGRESS, creates the feature branch on the matching repository, and returns the brief. One call instead of get_issue + update_issue + github_create_branch.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

assignee.description: Who takes it — name, email, id, or "me" (default)

createBranch.description: Create the feature branch on GitHub

repoId.description: Repository to branch from (inferred from the issue when omitted)

force.description: Start even if the issue is blocked or already closed

tools.name: submit_work
tools.description: Closes the loop on an issue: opens the pull request linked to it (body gets "Closes ZT-N", which moves the issue to IN_REVIEW now and to DONE on merge) and posts your summary as a comment on the issue.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

repoId.description: Repository (inferred from the issue when omitted)

title.description: PR title (derived from the issue when omitted)

summary.description: What you did — posted as a comment on the issue

tools.name: triage_inbox
tools.description: What is waiting for a decision: unclaimed open issues ranked by priority, plus monitor errors that are unresolved or regressed and not yet tracked by an issue. Each row carries the tool call that resolves it.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: standup
tools.description: What moved since a given window and what is at risk: issues closed, work in progress per person, items blocked, new bugs, and the active cycle with days left. Computed, not a prompt template.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: auth_setup
tools.description: Configures and validates your ZT Playground API key. Run once — the key is saved (0600) for future sessions.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Alias of whoami. Returns the authenticated user (the identity your API key acts as) and the API it talks to. Useful before assigning issues to yourself. Answers even when the API is unreachable, from the identity cached at setup.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user (the identity your API key acts as) and the API it talks to. Useful before assigning issues to yourself. Answers even when the API is unreachable, from the identity cached at setup.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: Lists the workspace users (id + name) — use to resolve an assignee name to an id.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Cross-project dashboard summary (counts, recent activity, at-a-glance health).

tools.name: global_search
tools.description: Project-scoped search across issues, repositories, and monitor errors (the ⌘K palette). Distinct from search_issues, which is issue-only.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

limit.description: Max results per entity (API caps at 20)

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists all available projects with their issue counts and members.

tools.name: get_platforms
tools.description: Lists the platforms configured for a project (used as the `platform` filter elsewhere).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Creates an issue (TASK, BUG, STORY) in a project. `assignee` accepts a name, email, user id or "me" — that is the only way to set an owner. Set `cycleId` to plan it straight into a cycle and `storyPoints` to estimate it. Description is capped at 2000 chars.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

assignee.description: Assignee — name, email, user id, or "me"

cycleId.description: Cycle to plan this issue into

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Fetches a single issue with its full context — description, assignee/reporter, parent, cycle, comments, attachments, relations (with direction, so "blocked by" is visible) and sub-issues. Accepts a raw id or a ZT-ref. Concise by default: description and comment bodies are trimmed to their first 1500/800 chars.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

verbosity.description: 'concise' (default) trims long description and comment bodies (the cut is marked inline). Ask for 'detailed' when you need a long spec or comment thread verbatim.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Updates an issue. Moving status here logs Activity and fires Automations (preferred over board moves). `assignee` accepts a name, email, user id or "me" — that is the only way to reassign; `unassign` clears the owner. Pass cycleId/storyPoints to plan and estimate; `removeFromCycle` takes it out of its cycle.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

assignee.description: Reassign — name, email, user id, or "me"

parentId.description: Re-parent under this epic (id or ZT-ref)

cycleId.description: Move the issue into this cycle

removeFromCycle.description: Take the issue out of its cycle

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Searches issues with filters, sorting and pagination. `status`, `type` and `priority` accept comma-separated lists ("IN_PROGRESS,IN_REVIEW"); `assignee` accepts a name/email/id or "none" for unclaimed work. Use this to find duplicates and related work before creating.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

type.description: TASK | BUG | STORY | EPIC (comma-separated for several)

status.description: TO_DO | IN_PROGRESS | IN_REVIEW | DONE | CANCELLED (comma-separated for several)

priority.description: MUITO_ALTA | ALTA | MEDIA | BAIXA (comma-separated for several)

assignee.description: Name, email, user id, "me", or "none" for unassigned

labels.description: Match issues carrying any of these labels

parentId.description: Children of this epic (id or ZT-ref), or "none" for top-level only

cycleId.description: Issues in this cycle, or "none" for unplanned

updatedSince.description: Only issues touched at/after this ISO date

order.description: Sort direction (default desc; use asc with priority for most urgent first)

verbosity.description: 'concise' (default) returns the identity fields you scan a result list with (ref, title, type, status, priority, assignee). Ask for 'detailed' when you need every projected field on every hit — platform, repository, area, points, labels, dates.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.description: Permanently deletes an issue. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: create_epic
tools.description: Creates an epic and its sub-tasks. Reports which children were created and which failed (no all-or-nothing), so a single bad child does not lose the rest.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tasks.description: Sub-tasks to create under the epic

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Reports a bug as a structured issue (steps to reproduce, expected/actual behaviour, environment). Description is capped at 2000 chars.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to an issue. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref (pass projectId to resolve a ZT-ref).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Lists the comments on an issue. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Attaches a base64-encoded file/image to an issue (≤5 MB). Note: attachments are stored on the API server’s local disk, which is ephemeral on serverless hosts — uploads may not persist there. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: Lists the attachments on an issue. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: manage_labels
tools.description: Adds and/or removes labels on an issue. Adds are idempotent (the API enforces one label name per issue). Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

color.description: Hex color applied to added labels (e.g. "#ef4444")

tools.name: link_issues
tools.description: Creates a relation between two issues (BLOCKS, RELATES_TO, DUPLICATES). Both ids accept a raw id or ZT-ref (pass projectId to resolve ZT-refs).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: unlink_issues
tools.description: Removes a relation from an issue. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref for the issue.

issueId.description: Issue ID or ZT-ref that holds the relation

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_relations
tools.description: Lists an issue’s relations from its own point of view — each entry says whether it blocks or is blocked by the other issue. `openBlockers` are the unfinished issues that must land first.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: list_cycles
tools.description: Lists the cycles (sprints) of a project with progress. Accepts a project name or id.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: create_cycle
tools.description: Creates a cycle (sprint) in a project. Requires name + start/end dates.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_cycle
tools.description: Fetches a cycle with its issues.

tools.name: update_cycle
tools.description: Updates a cycle — including activating it (status="ACTIVE") or changing dates/goal.

tools.name: complete_cycle
tools.description: Marks a cycle complete (moves remaining issues per the project’s policy).

tools.name: delete_cycle
tools.description: Permanently deletes a cycle.

tools.name: assign_issues_to_cycle
tools.description: Adds one or more issues to a cycle. Issue refs accept raw ids or ZT-refs (pass projectId to resolve ZT-refs).

issueIds.description: Issue IDs or ZT-refs to add

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: remove_issue_from_cycle
tools.description: Removes a single issue from a cycle. Accepts a raw id or ZT-ref (pass projectId to resolve).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_cycle_metrics
tools.description: Returns cycle progress + burndown (progress %, done/total issues, story points, burndown series, status breakdown).

tools.name: view_list
tools.description: Lists your saved views, optionally scoped to a project.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: view_create
tools.description: Creates a saved view (named issue filter). `filters` mirrors the issue-list query: { search?, status?, type?, priority? }.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: view_get
tools.description: Fetches a saved view by id.

tools.name: view_update
tools.description: Updates a saved view (name, filters, visibility, …).

tools.name: view_delete
tools.description: Deletes a saved view.

tools.name: view_set_default
tools.description: Marks a saved view as your default for its project.

tools.name: get_project_activity
tools.description: Recent activity feed for a project (creates, status changes, assignments, automations…).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_issue_activity
tools.description: Activity history for a single issue (its audit trail). Accepts an issue id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: The project’s Kanban board as counts per column plus the top issues of each, ordered by priority — not the whole board. Raise topN, or use search_issues, to go past the head of a column. To MOVE an issue between columns use update_issue (it logs Activity and fires Automations); the raw board status PATCH does not.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_project_health
tools.description: Issue-health analytics for a project — bug trends, problematic areas, health score.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_issue_overview
tools.description: Issue counts by status/type/priority over a window.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_issues_by_platform
tools.description: Issue breakdown grouped by platform.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_issue_trends
tools.description: Created-vs-resolved issue trends over time.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_area_analysis
tools.description: Issue breakdown by affected area. Optionally narrows to one area (filtered client-side, since the API groups by area).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: get_repository_report
tools.description: Issue breakdown by repository. Optionally narrows to one repository (filtered client-side).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_overview
tools.description: Error overview for a project — totals, unresolved, top errors, trend, platform breakdown.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_list_errors
tools.description: Lists error groups with filters and pagination. By default INFO/DEBUG telemetry is hidden (set includeInfoDebug=true or pass explicit severities to change). Sort is whitelisted server-side.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

severities.description: Explicit severity filter (overrides the noise default)

tools.name: monitor_get_error
tools.description: Details of an error group with its latest event. Concise by default: the top 10 stack frames, plus a note saying what was left out (rawStackTrace, breadcrumbs, extra, request). Output is size-capped.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

verbosity.description: 'concise' (default) projects the payload: top 10 stack frames, no rawStackTrace/breadcrumbs/extra. Ask for 'detailed' only when the concise answer is not enough — e.g. you need a breadcrumb trail or the unminified stack.

tools.name: monitor_get_error_events
tools.description: Lists individual events of an error group (message, stack, environment, tags). Concise by default — one event carries a full breadcrumb trail and a source-mapped stack, and a page of ten of them is a lot of context for little extra signal.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

verbosity.description: 'concise' (default) projects the payload: top 10 stack frames, no rawStackTrace/breadcrumbs/extra. Ask for 'detailed' only when the concise answer is not enough — e.g. you need a breadcrumb trail or the unminified stack.

tools.name: monitor_update_error
tools.description: Updates an error group’s status (resolve/ignore/reopen) and optionally assigns it.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_create_issue_from_error
tools.description: Converts a monitor error group into a tracked BUG issue (Sentry→Linear style). Idempotent: if the error already links to an active issue, returns it with created=false instead of duplicating.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_performance
tools.description: APM overview — avg/p50/p75/p95 durations, throughput, and platform breakdown.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_web_vitals
tools.description: Core Web Vitals (LCP/FCP/CLS/FID/TTFB) — avg and p75 per metric.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_endpoints
tools.description: Per-endpoint latency table (avg/p50/p75/p95, throughput, error rate).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_transactions
tools.description: Lists individual performance transactions (name/type/duration), paginated.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_error_platforms
tools.description: Lists the distinct platforms that have reported errors for a project.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_list_alerts
tools.description: Lists the monitor alert rules for a project.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_create_alert
tools.description: Creates a monitor alert rule (notifies a channel when conditions match).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

channelConfig.description: Channel config (e.g. { webhookUrl } for DISCORD, { url } for WEBHOOK/SLACK, { to } for EMAIL)

tools.name: monitor_update_alert
tools.description: Updates a monitor alert rule (rename, silence/disable, change conditions).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: monitor_delete_alert
tools.description: Deletes a monitor alert rule.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_overview
tools.description: GitHub integration overview for a project (linked repos, recent PR/commit activity).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_list_repos
tools.description: Lists the GitHub repositories linked to a project (with their ids for use in other tools).

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_list_branches
tools.description: Lists branches of a linked repository.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_list_commits
tools.description: Lists commits of a repository with optional filters.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_list_deployments
tools.description: Lists deployments for a repository.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_issue_git_activity
tools.description: Aggregated GitHub activity for an issue — its commits and pull requests (the issue-panel view). Accepts an issue id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_list_prs
tools.description: Lists pull requests for a repository with optional filters.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_get_pr_detail
tools.description: PR detail — state, mergeability, review states, a check summary and linked issues. Concise by default: the per-file list is replaced by counts (additions/deletions/filesChanged), since a PR can touch hundreds of files. Output is size-capped.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

verbosity.description: 'concise' (default) drops the changed-file list and the review bodies. Ask for 'detailed' when you actually need the file-by-file breakdown or a reviewer's full comment.

tools.name: github_get_pr_checks
tools.description: CI/CD check-run status for a pull request.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_create_branch
tools.description: Creates a feature branch from an issue (feature/ZT-{seq}-{slug}) and moves the issue to IN_PROGRESS. Accepts an issue id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

repoId.description: Repository ID (first linked repo if omitted)

tools.name: github_create_pr
tools.description: Creates a pull request. If issueId is given, the PR is linked and the body gets "Closes ZT-N" — which (Linear-style) moves the issue to IN_REVIEW now and to DONE when merged. Accepts an issue id or ZT-ref.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

title.description: PR title (auto-generated from the issue if omitted)

issueId.description: Issue ID or ZT-ref to link

tools.name: github_merge_pr
tools.description: Merges a pull request (merge/squash/rebase). Refuses if CI checks are failing or still pending unless force=true. If the PR closes an issue, that issue is moved to DONE automatically. Audited.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

force.description: Merge even if CI is not green (audited)

tools.name: github_pr_review
tools.description: Submits a PR review as you (APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / COMMENT). Approvals are submitted under your account — review the diff first. Audited.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: github_sync_repo
tools.description: Triggers a metadata sync (branches, PRs, commits) for a linked repository.

projectId.description: Project ID or name — defaults to the active project

tools.name: context_setup
tools.description: Creates or updates a project context (default ZT project, databases, SSH servers) and sets it active. Every product tool falls back to this project when none is given. Secrets are stored at ~/.zt-playground/contexts/*.json (0600) and are redacted when read back via context_get.

projectId.description: Project ID in ZT Playground

projectName.description: Project name (used as the config file name)

readOnly.description: If true, only read queries are allowed (writes blocked)
If true, ssh_exec is refused (only ssh_logs / ssh_status run)

tools.name: context_get
tools.description: Returns the active project context (default project, databases, SSH servers). Secrets (DB passwords, SSH passwords) are redacted.

tools.name: context_list
tools.description: Lists all saved project contexts.

tools.name: context_set_active
tools.description: Sets the active context — which ZT project every tool defaults to, plus the database/SSH targets. Persists across sessions.

tools.name: context_remove
tools.description: Removes a saved project context configuration.

tools.name: db_query
tools.description: Executes a read-only SQL query (SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN/SHOW). Runs inside a READ ONLY transaction with a statement timeout, so writes are rejected at the database level even if the statement tries to sneak one in. A LIMIT is auto-applied to bare SELECTs. Use db_execute for writes.

dbName.description: Database name from context (auto-selected if only one)

tools.name: db_execute
tools.description: Runs a write query (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL) inside a transaction, after confirmation. A client that supports elicitation is asked to confirm in-band and the statement runs in the same call; otherwise this returns a planId to pass to db_execute_confirm. Blocked if the database is configured read-only. Catastrophic statements (DROP/TRUNCATE, unscoped UPDATE/DELETE) are flagged.

tools.name: db_execute_confirm
tools.description: Confirms and executes a previously prepared write query by planId, wrapped in a transaction (rolled back on error). Audited.

tools.name: db_schema
tools.description: Lists tables or describes a table’s columns via information_schema.

table.description: Table name to describe (omit to list all tables)

tools.name: ssh_exec
tools.description: Executes a command on a remote server via SSH. The host key is verified (trust-on-first-use; pin via pinnedHostKey). Refused if the server is configured read-only. Catastrophic patterns are blocked unless allowDangerous=true. All executions are audited.

serverName.description: SSH server name from context (auto-selected if only one)

allowDangerous.description: Override the safety denylist (recorded in the audit log)

tools.name: ssh_logs
tools.description: Tails a log file on a remote server with an optional grep filter (values are shell-escaped).

logPath.description: Path to the log file on the server

tools.name: ssh_status
tools.description: Gets server health (uptime, memory, disk, top processes).
